text:
elaine: Quick draft of the private deploy pocket slate is in the drive: https://drive.redwood.example/private-deploy-pager. Short bullets: SLA tiers, network/topology options, KMS/HSM integrations, rollout/rollback plan. Need final copy for webinar sign-up page by EOD. Who can proof?

raj: I'll take SLA bullets. Do we have numbers for 99.9 vs 99.95 latency targets? :thinking:

samir: We can claim 99.9 SLA for shared clusters, 99.95 for dedicated pools with reserved capacity. Latency numbers from the benchmark: p50=120ms, p95=380ms on 8k-token sequence using optimized runtime + batching. Cost notes: ~0.6x per-token vs baseline when using KV caching and quantized kernels.

zoe: Messaging suggestion: lead with 'Predictable inference at enterprise scale' then three bullets: security controls, predictable throughput (dedicated), and graceful degradation/fallbacks. Keep the CTA 'Request an enterprise trial'.

elaine: Legal — any wording flags on 'data never leaves customer VPC' line? @legal-ops

legal-ops: ok to say 'customer-managed VPC' and 'data does not traverse Redwood public network when using Private with VPC peering' — avoid absolute 'never'. Recommend 'remains under customer control' language.

raj: For inbound routing: route leads who select 'Private deploy' to #ae-enterprise + add tag 'vpc-onprem' in HubSpot. Samir, can you drop the short tech spec we want in the lead form?

samir: Suggested form fields: 'Estimated peak qps', 'Priority SLA tier', 'Compliance/regulatory constraints' + checkbox 'on-prem required'. Follow-up flow: AE gets auto-email + create FieldOps ticket with prefilled tech spec.

zoe: Webinar plan: 20m talk, 10m demo of private setup (control plane + on-prem agent), 15m Q+A. Slide order: 1) problem statement, 2) deployment modes matrix, 3) benchmark numbers (samir pls), 4) customer scenarios, 5) next steps + CTA.

elaine: Can someone write the 2-line registration copy? need headline + subhead for landing page.

samir: Headline: 'Bring enterprise-grade inference anywhere'. Subhead: 'Private deployments, SLA-backed capacity, predictable economics — see the benchmarks.' CTA: 'Reserve a trial & join the webinar'.

zoe: I like it. I'll run an A/B: 'Reserve a trial' vs 'Request a private trial' on the landing page. Add UTM params: utm_campaign=private-deploy-webinar.

calendar-bot: Webinar slot booked: Apr 15 10:00 PDT. Reminders: 7d / 1d / 1h.

elaine: Perfect. Final checklist before I drop the one-pager in #field-sales after lunch: legal language updated, SLA bullets from raj, benchmark numbers from samir, registration copy + AB test from zoe, inbound routing implemented by raj. If no objections I'll push PDF at 1pm. :thumbsup:
